Messages.Author: madma...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Folks:

From Ethan Burrow's most excellent web site (3 cheers!!), I have
gleaned the following information on a new Sabbat War card:

Vagabond Mystic
Unique ally with 2 life, 0 strength, 0 bleed.

Tap Vagabond Mystic to move 1 life counter from the blood bank to an
ally you control if that ally has fewer life than his or her starting
amount. The Vagabond Mystic cannot block vampires.

There is no mention of any sort of preprequisite clan, etc. for this
ally. There is also no mention of any cost for this ally.

Can this be true?? A free ally available to anyone?? Is this too good
to be true??

I also presume that the Mystic does not require an *action* to add a
life. He simply adds a life by tapping.

Yeow!!!

Madman (who is inordinately fond of allies, particularly Nephandus)

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:

> One more ally-related question: I understand that an ally can recruit
> another ally if the first ally meets all requirements. For example,
> could Nephandus recruit Talaq the Immortal? Could Talaq recruit the

Yes. Allies can be recruited by anyone just, in the majority of cases,
clan requirements get in the way.

Where no clan is required (or other vampiric ability), allies can do it
too.
